scope: complete assigned Appetizer PDF, including all precise exercises and operative mathematical content
review: single-agent self-review plus kernel checks; no independent semantic review claimed
process_isolation: macOS Seatbelt applied to the entire Harness process and descendants; deny user/project/temp data except clean workspace and approved runtimes; outbound TCP limited to the local fixed-model proxy
network_allowed: local model meter and local Harness UI only
credentials: upstream key remains in observer-side private store; Harness receives only a distinct local proxy credential

measurement.cost_basis: actual returned OpenRouter usage with missing values reconciled, not estimates
measurement.setup_phase: warm protocol and environment readiness, excluding this local preparation and prior installations

limitations: Pretraining exposure is not assessed by local file isolation.
This is a new custom generic protocol, not the full upstream book-formalization skill or its canonical acceptance process.
Operating-system/Harness and generic tool runtimes are infrastructure; the only supplied mathematical library beyond Lean core is pinned Mathlib and its dependencies.
session_policy: fresh Appetizer-only state; no previous Appetizer or Chapter 1 session history imported
inner_shell_policy: DSH danger-full-access inside unchanged outer OS read/write/network confinement; avoids unsupported nested Seatbelt
